traversin sees itself as a forum for the search for parallels in architecture, art, and the sciences by way of projects and theoretical discussions.

We are conceiving a theoretically oriented journal that aims to approach the subject of “design” in general. By this we mean the attempt to overcome the boundaries between the various disciplines that generally deal with design methods – engineers, architects, designers, scholars in the humanities and natural scientists. The design of cities, buildings, objects, theories, or models for approaching worlds of any kind has, at its beginnings, a common starting point that connects them, a similar method – or at least parallel approaches to solving a problem can be observed.
Against this broadly sketched background, it seems interesting to us to examine various disciplines for their potential to give the concept of design a new direction of thought, for example by applying strategies from biology, such as evolution and selection, to design methods.
